title: Ukraine sanctions 51 Russians and 44 firms supplying long-range missile makers
note: Kyiv's first list targets suppliers of raw materials, equipment and tools used in Iskander, Kalibr, Kh-101 and Kinzhal missiles. It aims at the supply chain behind Russian strikes as attacks on Ukrainian cities intensify.

title: US president says US may launch another 'little Epic Fury' attack on Iran
note: The US president referred to the joint US-Israeli operation that began the war in late February and said a new strike could follow. Iranian officials say they will not back down, which raises the risk of renewed large-scale combat.
limitations: A public remark is not an order, and the timing and scale of any strike are not stated. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: Aid agencies warn of emergency in Taiz as Houthi forces encircle city and block aid
note: UN agencies say aid is blocked from entering Taiz City, which Houthi forces have encircled while fighting government troops along the west coast. A separate report describes dwindling drinking water in the besieged city.
limitations: The summary gives no casualty or population figures, and access claims come from aid agencies without a response from the Houthis. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: White House eases US tariffs on some Canadian goods and adds them on others
note: From 30 October the US will ease tariffs on products such as certain machinery and place them on others such as carpets. The change comes weeks before US midterm elections and after a lawsuit over the earlier tariffs.
limitations: The summary does not give the trade value covered or how Canada will respond. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: US president says warships returning from Iran could intervene in Cuba
note: At a rally the US president suggested ships heading home from the Iran war might act in Cuba. The US secretary of state then told Cubans seeking political change that 'now is the time' to act, which widens US pressure to a second theatre.
limitations: The remarks were made at a campaign rally and no military order or plan is reported. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: Mass protests and riots in France test the government after student-led mobilisation
note: Student protests over school conditions have grown into a broader movement with unions and civil society, and an academic cited in the coverage refers to 500,000 people on the streets.
